name: Tuzla Tour Guide App
description: Multilingual interactive tour guide for Tuzla, Bosnia and Herzegovina. Features 3D GPS navigation, AR Quests with QR code scanning and collecting rewards, audio guides, personal itinerary planner with expense ledger, transportation info, verified hotel and dining directories, it is the only app you will need for full exploration of City of Tuzla.

shortcuts.name: AR Quest & Scavenger Hunt
shortcuts.description: Explore Tuzla landmarks in Augmented Reality, scan QR codes and earn rewards

shortcuts.name: 3D GPS Map & Navigation
shortcuts.description: Navigate Tuzla with live 3D vector maps, routing, and offline support

shortcuts.name: Transportation
shortcuts.description: Information about transportation in Tuzla, bus, taxi, car rental

shortcuts.name: Personal Itinerary & Expenses
shortcuts.description: Organize your stay, check off visited places, and track travel expenses
